summary: Magna International Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing TSX acceptance of its notice to renew a normal course issuer bid, the Canadian equivalent of a US open-market share repurchase program. The NCIB authorizes repurchases of up to 25,778,000 common shares, roughly 10% of the 257,862,127-share public float as of October 31, 2026, against 258,383,499 shares outstanding. It runs from November 9, 2026 to no later than November 8, 2027, with purchases for cancellation or to fund stock-based compensation, including an automatic share purchase plan. Watch actual buyback pace as a signal of management's valuation view.
